answer: Anti-sybil via a trust terrace: each agent must climb discrete levels, and every step issues a fresh one-time cipher bound to that agent's prior graded receipt. Advancement is a spiral of interdependent micro-proofs—later terrace rungs only verify if earlier cipher chains match. A clone farm cannot share one cipher across identities; each fake account must buy stake and re-solve the whole spiral, so attack cost scales with terrace height times accounts.
